notes: Heuristic lexical diagnostics only; human judgment and conversion data outrank this score.
Low proof score may be appropriate when the format does not require explicit proof.

self_cta.label: Curiosity
self_cta.human_test: Remove the CTA and link. Would a qualified reader already want to ask how to get, see, try, continue, or learn more?

truthfulness.principle: Flags are verification prompts, not automatic findings of falsehood.

claims.claim: The electrical relationships, expected behavior, and practical use cases were mine to define; AI-assisted implementation offered a way to turn those decisions into Flutter code and an interface much faster than starting every component manually.
My experience was smaller in scale and different in method, but the practical implication resonates: faster output doesn't compensate for an unclear objective.

claim_proof_alignment.note: Lexical proximity heuristic only. Human review must determine whether the evidence actually supports the magnitude, population, timeframe, and causal meaning of the claim.

believability.note: Heuristic. A nearby proof word does not establish factual support; inspect the actual evidence.

specificity.note: Specificity is not automatically truth. Verify all concrete claims and numbers.

offer_transition.human_test: Does the paragraph before the offer create a genuine, truthful next-step need that the offer resolves?

comparison_truth.note: A nearby evidence signal is not proof. Verify scope, equivalence, time period, and source.

scarcity_truth.principle: Scarcity is allowed only when it is real, material, and externally/operationally grounded.

risk_reversal.note: Absence is not automatically a problem. Use risk reversal only when decision friction is material and the underlying terms are real.

pressure_budget.label: LOW
pressure_budget.note: Truth and context outrank the score. Real deadlines are information, but repeated pressure can still harm trust.

glanceability.note: A short personal email may not need headings/bullets. Use channel judgment; avoid both walls of text and artificial one-line stacking.

post_purchase_clarity.note: Not every format needs post-purchase detail. Use for offers where uncertainty after action may create friction.

sales_letter_coverage.note: Risk reversal and P.S. are optional. Coverage detects presence, not quality.

narrative_profile.label: NARRATIVE-HEAVY
narrative_profile.note: Narrative presence is descriptive, not a quality score. Low narrative is valid.

narrative_overload.note: High narrative density is not automatically bad; this flags story that may be crowding out reader relevance or momentum.

provider.note: Low score is not automatically a defect when provider operations are not material to the copy.

provider_trust.note: Low score is not automatically a defect when provider operations are not material to the copy.

issues: first desire/outcome signal appears after first CTA

presupposition_integrity.note: Flags identify premises requiring evidence/context review; they are not automatic proof of manipulation.

question_form.note: Form diversity is descriptive, not a target. Use the least-leading form that does the job.

commitment_consistency_integrity.note: A prior yes or micro-commitment is context to verify, not an obligation to remain consistent.

problem_definition_integrity.note: Define and evidence the problem before dramatizing it; do not enlarge it to make the offer inevitable.

refusal_boundary.note: A stable refusal, opt-out, or poor-fit signal ends persuasion unless the person explicitly reopens the conversation.

decision_criteria_integrity.note: Emotion may make relevance vivid, but it must not displace the criteria, evidence, trade-offs, or constraints that should govern the decision.

rapport_integrity.note: Rapport, similarity, and mirroring may support understanding; they must not be used as concealed resistance-lowering devices.

material_information_transparency.note: Curiosity may delay non-material detail; price, terms, constraints, risks, and decision-critical facts must be available before commitment.

cumulative_pressure_sequence.note: Pressure compounds across a page, conversation, and sequence. Review the stack, not only individual sentences.

objection_legitimacy.note: An objection may be reflex, uncertainty, a real constraint, or a disqualifier. Do not assume resistance by default.

buyer_story_elicitation_integrity.note: Elicit event/context voluntarily; disclosure is not a debt and vulnerability is not a conversion target.

narrative_causal_integrity.note: Narrative sequence is not causal proof. Match causal language to mechanism/evidence and state conditions/limits.

narrative_inference_gap.note: Readers fill narrative gaps from prior knowledge. Surface missing links when a likely inference could materially overstate cause, outcome, fit, or guarantee.

narrative_resolution_space.note: Do not use a high emotional resolution as a shortcut to immediate commitment. Restore decision space for consequential choices.

abstraction_concreteness.note: Heuristic only. Metaphor/example should clarify structure; it does not replace evidence.

proof_architecture.note: Proof architecture describes support modes only. It does not verify that claims are factually true.

authority_integrity.note: Authority is legitimate only when relevant, verifiable, and bounded; it must not substitute for independent evaluation.

reciprocity_integrity.note: Value may be offered freely; it must not manufacture felt debt or commercial compliance.

interaction_reinforcement_integrity.note: Reinforce learning/progress, not agreement with the seller.

community_fit_integrity.note: Truthful fit/community is allowed; exclusion anxiety and fabricated belonging are not.

risk_communication_integrity.note: Material risk may be vivid only when evidenced, proportionate and compatible with real alternatives.

context_cue_integrity.note: Environment, display, time and attention cues must represent real conditions.

time_attention_transparency.note: Time, deadlines, waiting, attention capture and exit controls must reflect real conditions and preserve a genuine ability to disengage.

privacy_discovery_integrity.note: Progressive discovery must remain permission-based, relevant and non-exploitative.

semantic_repetition_integrity.note: Restatement is allowed for comprehension/recall; unnoticed conditioning is not.

audience_language_integrity.note: Audience-native language should be evidence-grounded and used for comprehension, never resistance-lowering mirroring.

contextual_quality.note: Contextual global is a job-routed diagnostic. It does not replace raw validators, hard constraints, factual verification, or conversion evidence.

narrative_self_cta.label: SELF-CTA NARRATIVE
narrative_self_cta.note: Use only when a narrative is intentionally present. Direct copy should not be penalized for a low narrative score.

character_goal_obstacle.note: A missing BIG Three element does not make copy bad; it means the passage may function as an incident/example rather than a full story.
